name: Trust-First Peter
segment: Security-oriented retired Swiss with stable pension income, strong cash preference and low digital adoption

demographic_profile.household: Couple, own home in rural Aargau
demographic_profile.disposable_income: Approx. CHF 4,000–5,500/month (retiree household, below national avg of CHF 6,902)
demographic_profile.health_expenditure: CHF 221/month national avg — retiree significantly higher

behavioral_profile.primary_payment_method: Cash — dominant, especially for daily spending
behavioral_profile.secondary_payment_method: Debit card (PostFinance) for supermarkets and larger purchases
behavioral_profile.mobile_payment: Very limited — 55+ group lowest mobile adoption
behavioral_profile.credit_card_usage: Rarely — avoids debt and credit products

financial_behavior.attitude_toward_fees: Resistant — fixed income, dislikes unnecessary costs
financial_behavior.attitude_toward_atm_fees: Frustrated — almost half of Swiss find ATM fees unreasonable
financial_behavior.cash_attitude: Strongly values cash — 68% of Swiss want cash unchanged, Peter firmly in this group
financial_behavior.willingness_to_pay: CHF 0–5/month maximum, only if absolutely necessary

payment_mindset.digital_comfort: Low — uses e-banking but avoids new apps
payment_mindset.attitude_toward_fintech: Skeptical — prefers PostFinance and cantonal banks

brand_loyalty: High — loyal to PostFinance and cantonal banks
